Name: Will's Citrus Mod
Author: Willcraftapple11
Description:
The farmer in Stardew Valley doesn't get enough Vitamin C in their diet so I added more citrus.
Adds Lemon, Lime, Grapefruit, and Tangerine trees. Alongside Lemonade and Limeade.
The trees can be purchased from Pierre's for reasonable prices, and you can learn the recipes for the drinks through the powers of friendship (see the What's New section for more information).
[b]
After almost two years, I've finally updated this mod for 1.6! [/b]Sorry JsonAssets but Content patcher is my new beau now.[b]
[/b]What's new?[b]
[/b][spoiler]
[list]
[*]Updated for Content Patcher.
[*]Added Tangerines! These superior oranges are able to be harvested in Fall.
[*]Did some retexturing- the trees should look different now and so do the fruit. I've redone the fruit textures. The drinks remain the same because I can't improve on perfection.
[*]Speaking of drinks, [b]I've changed how you get the recipe for Lemonade and Limeade. [/b]You need to befriend [b]Gus[/b] and [b]Evelyn[/b] to unlock these recipes now.
[/list]
[/spoiler]
[b]
[/b]Past Updates:
[spoiler][b]
In 1.1:
[/b]Adds citrus trees and fruit.
Adds lemon trees, a winter fruit
Adds lime trees, a summer fruit
And adds grapefruit trees, a fall fruit.
All are purchasable from Pierre!

[b]And now in 1.2!:
[/b]I changed the names of the citrus trees and their products to avoid conflict with PPJA's MoreTrees and PPJA's EvenMoreRecipes
So [b]grapefruits[/b] are now [b]strong,[/b] [b]limes[/b] are now [b]refreshing[/b], and [b]lemons[/b] are now [b]zesty[/b]! This includes the trees.
I also added lemonade and (iced) limeade! You know both recipes by default.
-To make lemonade you need:
﻿-[b] Two Zesty Lemons
[/b] ﻿- [b]One Sugar[/b]
-To make iced limeade you need:
﻿[b]- Two Refreshing Limes
[/b] ﻿- [b]Two Sugar
Both[/b] of these drinks you can purchase at the saloon for 800 (lemonade) or 700 (limeade). Lemonade is not available in winter.[/spoiler]


Thank you to all of the people who have already downloaded my mod! It means a lot to me that y'all are enjoying my citrus :)
